planned_math_to_code.statement: Minimize <c,Pi>+gamma(1^T s+1^T t)+epsilon sum Pi(log Pi-1).
At epsilon=0, adding a small transport mass removes the same mass from each slack, changing cost by (c_ij-2gamma) times mass.
Every unmatched source vertex still receives the frozen native decoder prediction.
